WITH shelter_data AS (
  SELECT 
    e."EQUIP_CODE",
    e."EquipType",
    e."model_name",
    ce."loc_link" AS station_name,
    -- Extract heater_state from JSONB
    (ce."cabin_env_snapshot"->'hvac'->>'heater_state') AS heater_state,
    -- Get insulationStat from ThermalSolarWindAndGrid via comm_link chain
    tsw."insulationStat",
    -- Get emerLightStat from LightingAndSafety
    ls."emerLightStat",
    -- Weather data for SSF calculation
    ws."structLoadPct",
    ws."snowLoad_kgm2",
    ws."windSpeed_ms"
  FROM "Equipment" e
  JOIN "CabinEnvironment" ce ON e."EQUIP_CODE" = ce."equipRef"
  LEFT JOIN "WeatherAndStructure" ws ON ce."loc_link" = ws."loc_link"
  LEFT JOIN "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" tsw ON ws."WEATHER_ID" = tsw."THERMAL_ID"
  LEFT JOIN "LightingAndSafety" ls ON e."EQUIP_CODE" = ls."equipRef"
  WHERE e."EquipType" = 'Shelter'
)
SELECT *,
  CASE 
    WHEN ("snowLoad_kgm2" > 100 OR "windSpeed_ms" > 20) THEN 0.5
    WHEN ("snowLoad_kgm2" > 50 OR "windSpeed_ms" > 10) THEN 0.8
    ELSE 1.0
  END AS multiplier,
  (100 - "structLoadPct")::numeric / 100 * 
    CASE 
      WHEN ("snowLoad_kgm2" > 100 OR "windSpeed_ms" > 20) THEN 0.5
      WHEN ("snowLoad_kgm2" > 50 OR "windSpeed_ms" > 10) THEN 0.8
      ELSE 1.0
    END AS SSF
FROM shelter_data LIMIT 5;
